question:
DRAG DROP -
An engineer must restore the startup configuration of a switch from a previously saved configuration file stored in bootflash.
Drag and drop the commands from the left into the correct order of operations on the right.
theory: Restoring a switch's startup configuration from a saved bootflash file follows a defined order: first confirm the current startup-config with "show startup-config," then "write erase" to clear it, "reload" the switch so it boots without a startup config, copy the saved file from bootflash into the running-configuration with "copy bootflash:<file> running-config," and finally save that restored running-configuration back to startup-config with "copy running-config startup-config" so it persists. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — Configuration Recovery)
